minutes.headline: ZBA continued the 691 Chase Road paving-yard special permit hearing to April 13 so the applicant can file a proper site plan.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard an application for a special permit to use 691 Chase Road as a contractor's yard for a paving and excavating business. Two abutter letters raised groundwater, runoff, odor, noise and the temporary trailer, and the board said the site plan was incomplete. The applicant asked for a continuance and the board voted to continue without prejudice to April 13 at 7 pm.

public_comment.topic: Asked what the intended uses are and what a contractor's yard permits; worried that a change such as diesel washing, or a sale of the business, could occur later; main concern is groundwater for well-water properties.

votes.motion: Continue the hearing without prejudice to April 13 at 7 pm.
votes.outcome: passed (voice vote, ayes heard, no opposition audible)

decisions.decision: The chair said any permit would be conditioned so the applicant must return to the board for any expansion or change of the business.
The chair said the temporary trailer is not permitted long term and could only be allowed for a limited conditioned period.
The hearing was continued to April 13 at 7 pm.
